title: Strut Health reviews: what it sells, what it costs, and who prescribes
summary: Strut Health reviews, November 2026 prices for compounded and retail medicines, BBB ratings, and how a $40 FutureClinic physician visit compares.
body_markdown:
## Strut Health vs Hims and Maximus


[Hims](https://www.hims.com/hair-loss/finasteride) starts finasteride at $22/mo,[generic Viagra](https://www.hims.com/erectile-dysfunction) at $22/mo, and 3-in-1 Hard Mints at $30/mo (November 18, 2026).[Maximus](https://www.maximustribe.com/) uses "US-based, fully licensed, board-certified physicians" and sells[testosterone](https://www.maximustribe.com/testosterone) ($99.99/mo injectable on a 10-month plan), enclomiphene ($99.99/mo on a 9-month plan), and[ED plans from $35.99/mo](https://www.maximustribe.com/vardenafil-tadalafil-sildenafil-bloodflow) (November 18, 2026).


## What do the same medicines cost as generics?


At[Cost Plus Drugs](https://api.costplusdrugs.com/pricelist/cpd) (November 2026, $5.25 shipping extra), 30-count generics cost[$5.82 for finasteride 1 mg](https://www.costplusdrugs.com/medications/finasteride-1mg-tablet/) ($7.47 for 90),[$6.10 for minoxidil 2.5 mg](https://www.costplusdrugs.com/medications/minoxidil-2_5mg-tablet-loniten/) ,[$6.36 for sildenafil 50 mg](https://www.costplusdrugs.com/medications/sildenafilcitrate-50mg-tablet/) ,[$5.97 for tadalafil 5 mg](https://www.costplusdrugs.com/medications/tadalafil-5mg-tablet/) , and[$7.46 for dutasteride 0.5 mg](https://www.costplusdrugs.com/medications/dutasteride-0_5mg-capsule-avodart/) . Six months of Strut finasteride is $150; two 90-day Cost Plus fills total $14.94 before shipping, plus a $40 FutureClinic visit, if your doctor decides it's right for you.

## Who should pick Strut Health


Strut Health suits someone who wants one of its compounded formulas, such as the Super Strut 4-in-1 tablet, HairfectRx capsules, or a 5-in-1 topical. It also fits patients who want medicine priced into one monthly auto-refill bill, or a phone or video consultation on request.


FutureClinic has no proprietary combinations or compounded products of its own. FutureClinic sends prescriptions only to the pharmacy you choose, and the medicine is never bundled into what you pay. FutureClinic does not offer live video visits. A FutureClinic doctor replies in hours rather than minutes, typically the same day.


## Why patients choose a physician on FutureClinic


Ask what you came for: a monthly auto-refill of a compounded formula, or a physician of your own who picks an FDA-approved medicine and sends it to your pharmacy? If you want Strut's formula, Strut sells it. If you wanted an expert physician with nothing attached, FutureClinic gives you that.


FutureClinic has over 300 doctors. Our network covers more than 60 specialties, with generalists and specialists alike. Every clinician is a board-certified, state-licensed physician with an MD, DO or MBBS degree, never a nurse practitioner or physician assistant; pay $40 for the best-fit doctor or pick a physician at their listed price, typically $20 to $100. Your doctor checks[pregnancy risk at home](https://futureclinic.com/blog/finasteride-for-hair-loss-explained-a-beginners-guide-from-a-dermatologist) , PSA history ([finasteride lowers PSA](https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/search.cfm?query=propecia) ),[blood pressure, and nitrates](https://futureclinic.com/blog/ed-treatment-online-sildenafil-tadalafil-no-subscription) (contraindicated with sildenafil and tadalafil), then sends a Human Signature video or voice note. No form is approved in bulk.


FutureClinic sells no medicines, and your doctor earns nothing extra for any prescription or test. If your doctor decides it's right for you, prescriptions go to the pharmacy you choose with a discount coupon. Because[finasteride](https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/search.cfm?query=propecia) takes three months or more to work and stopping reverses gains within 12 months, you can message the same doctor in one thread over time, with replies typically the same day. That doctor can treat other problems in their specialty, like acne, and every FutureClinic doctor uses your one medical record. Most doctors also offer an optional membership with unlimited care, cancel any time, typically $25 to $100 a month.


## When ED or low testosterone needs a blood test


The[AUA testosterone guideline](https://www.auanet.org/documents/Guidelines/PDF/Testosterone%20Website%20Final(0).pdf) requires symptoms or signs plus two early-morning total testosterone tests on separate days (300 ng/dL cut-off) then an LH check if testosterone is low. The[AUA ED guideline](https://www.auanet.org/documents/Guidelines/PDF/ED-JU.pdf) notes ED can signal heart disease and advises morning testosterone testing; erections over 4 hours or sudden vision loss need emergency care. FutureClinic physicians order discounted labs and prescribe FDA-approved medicines if your doctor decides it's right for you, excluding controlled drugs like[Schedule III testosterone](https://dailymed.nlm.nih.gov/dailymed/search.cfm?query=depo-testosterone) and compounded GLP-1s. FutureClinic is not for emergencies: call 911, or call or text 988 in a mental-health crisis.

Your doctor must be licensed in your state; if you don't see yours, try anyway.
